subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI messages can reach shared context but still not appear in Open WebUI visible chat history

question: Should OpenClaw core own syncing external Control UI turns into Open WebUI visible history, and through what supported boundary?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear, but the implementation depends on maintainer intent for third-party Open WebUI persistence ownership, direct SQLite/schema coupling versus API/plugin/adapter integration, opt-in configuration, and historical backfill behavior.

options.title: Opt-in core integration
options.body: Add an explicit, documented Open WebUI sync path only after live proof of the current schema/API contract, with focused tests and a repair/backfill story.

options.title: Route through plugin or adapter
options.body: Keep core lean by requiring the Open WebUI-specific mirror to live behind a plugin/integration boundary, adding only a missing generic core API seam if needed.

options.title: Document unsupported co-editing
options.body: Decide that OpenClaw owns transcript/model context only for this workflow and document that Control UI sends do not update Open WebUI visible history.

recommendation.title: Opt-in core integration
recommendation.body: Add an explicit, documented Open WebUI sync path only after live proof of the current schema/API contract, with focused tests and a repair/backfill story.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Gateway chat/session and Control UI history makes this the best available owner for the product and persistence-boundary decision.
